rationale: The claim is an interruption of the trip, but the reason, that the customer realized her child had been left at home and returned, is not one of the five covered reasons in section 2 of the policy wording (sickness, severe weather, uninhabitable home or destination, jury duty or subpoena, job loss). Section 2 states that 'We do not pay for cancellation or interruption for any other reason', so neither the $1,920 fare nor the $420 unused hotel share is payable.
